name: Materials Project non-crystalline AIMD and diffusivity database
description: Ab initio molecular-dynamics liquid and quenched inorganic systems, with ionic diffusivities and non-equilibrium structures.
version: 2024 publication cohort; 5000 K and multi-temperature releases
count_scope: The paper reports 5,120 systems in the 5000 K cohort, spanning 4,849 distinct compositions. Lower-temperature runs and trajectory frames are additional dependent observations.
provenance: MPMorph AIMD workflows seeded from Materials Project compositions; non-crystalline trajectories are new calculations
license: Not verified for dataset files; MPContribs labels project CCA4, but release-file terms were not independently checked

sources.title: Non-crystalline structure database paper
sources.evidence: Data scope distinguishes 5,120 5000 K systems, 4,849 compositions, and 220 compounds studied at lower temperatures; data availability names MPContribs and Figshare.

sources.title: Author data/code repository
sources.evidence: README links downloadable structure/diffusivity JSON and the full AIMD trajectory distribution.

sources.title: Live MPContribs project
sources.evidence: Download controls include structures and tables; temperature and element-specific diffusivities are displayed. Project badge reads CCA4.

caveats: The phase cannot universally be assigned as glass versus liquid; do not label every system an amorphous solid.
System count is not the number of unique compositions or trajectory snapshots.
No all-payload enumeration or deduplication was performed.

additional_counts.scope: Distinct compositions in the 5000 K cohort
Lower-temperature cohort; not added to parent system count

name: IAEA CascadesDB collision-cascade simulations
description: Atomistic irradiation-damage simulations for elemental metals, including collision cascades, vacancy clusters and dislocation debris.
count_scope: Provider homepage reports 17,024 simulations distributed in 320 archives, approximately 815 GB.
provenance: IAEA-curated contributions from independently published molecular-dynamics radiation-damage studies
license: CC BY 4.0 for data and metadata unless individually stated otherwise

sources.title: IAEA CascadesDB homepage
sources.evidence: Live HTML states 17,024 simulations in 320 archives; deposits use plain-text XYZ files.

sources.title: CascadesDB metadata specification
sources.evidence: Documents material lattice, simulation box, recoil conditions, code and archive fields.

sources.title: CascadesDB data licence
sources.evidence: Explicitly applies CC BY 4.0 to data and metadata unless stated otherwise.

caveats: Simulations, archives and coordinate frames are different denominators.
Elemental bulk, surfaces and initially damaged cells are mixed; inspect metadata before reuse.
Underlying contributor releases may overlap other irradiation datasets.

additional_counts.scope: Live distribution archive count; not independent materials

name: Quantum Defects Database — semiconductor point defects
description: Calculated point-defect structures and electronic/optical properties for quantum applications in diamond, silicon carbide and silicon.
version: 2023 paper cohort; living public interface checked 2026-11-01
count_scope: Paper reports over 50,000 point-defect calculations. Charge states and excited states are not independent host materials.
provenance: High-throughput first-principles semiconductor defect calculations by Ivanov and collaborators
license: Not verified; public access does not establish a reuse licence

sources.title: Database of semiconductor point-defect properties for applications in quantum technologies
sources.evidence: Author abstract reports over 50,000 calculated defects and publicly available relaxed structures.

sources.title: Live example: Ta substitution and Si interstitial
sources.evidence: Public example supplies charge-state controls, energies, spin information and a POSCAR-format structure download. A Si search returned 400 indexed results.

caveats: Paper-cohort lower bound is retained; live total was not verified.
Distinct from QPOD, which focuses on intrinsic defects in two-dimensional materials.
Properties are computed predictions and require application-specific validation.

name: Homer aluminum grain-boundary structures across 5D space
description: Minimum-energy aluminum grain boundaries spanning macroscopic crystallographic character, with atomic coordinates and computed boundary properties.
count_scope: Released ZIP contains 7,304 minimized LAMMPS structures, one for each unique macroscopic grain boundary.
provenance: EAM-conjugate-gradient optimization of aluminum bicrystals over many microscopic initial configurations

sources.title: Computed Aluminum Grain Boundary Structures and Energies Covering the 5D Space
sources.evidence: Provider states 7,304 minimum-energy LAMMPS structure files plus property CSV and CC BY 4.0.

caveats: Only atoms within ±15 angstrom of the boundary plane are retained; files are truncated boundary regions.
The 43,009,236 configurations minimized during search are not the count of structures in this release.
Distinct from the existing FCC Cu dislocation–grain-boundary interaction corpus.

name: GBDB elemental-metal grain-boundary DFT database
description: DFT grain-boundary structures and properties across elemental FCC, BCC and HCP metals.
version: 2020 paper cohort; current Crystalium route checked 2026-11-01
count_scope: Publication cohort contains 327 grain boundaries across 58 elements.
provenance: High-throughput scaled-template DFT calculations by Zheng and collaborators; distributed through Materials Project and Crystalium

sources.title: Grain boundary properties of elemental metals
sources.evidence: Paper states 327 structures across 58 elements, and distribution on Materials Project and Crystalium.

sources.title: Live Crystalium Fe data endpoint
sources.evidence: Returned 10 Fe grain-boundary records including lattice/site coordinates, boundary energies, and work of separation alongside separate surface records.

caveats: Count is the documented paper cohort rather than an independently enumerated live total.
Crystalium also supplies surfaces; those are excluded from this grain-boundary cohort.
DFT values differ in provenance from empirical-potential GB datasets.

additional_counts.scope: Element coverage of the paper cohort

name: Bond-focused grain-boundary solute interaction spectra
description: Spectral grain-boundary thermodynamic parameters for binary alloy segregation and solute interactions.
count_scope: Provider describes approximately 200 binary systems with EAM potentials available from NIST.
provenance: EAM calculations of grain-boundary segregation and interaction spectra; not DFT or experimental measurements

sources.title: Bond-Focused Local Atomic Environment Representation supplemental data
sources.evidence: Provider describes approximately 200 binary systems, a downloadable spectral database and CC BY 4.0 licensing.

caveats: Binary-system count is not atom count or the number of segregation-site energy labels.
Atomic-coordinate payload availability was not verified; this record represents released property spectra.

name: Kumagai oxygen-vacancy database
description: Charged oxygen-vacancy calculations in nonmagnetic insulating oxides, with defect geometry, formation energies and electronic information.
count_scope: Paper analyzes 937 oxide hosts, with inequivalent oxygen sites and three charge states. Host count is used instead of the approximate total defect calculations.
provenance: New PBEsol(+U) and non-self-consistent dielectric-dependent hybrid calculations; hosts selected from Materials Project
license: CC BY 4.0 explicitly for all data in the author repository

sources.title: Oxygen vacancy database author release
sources.evidence: README explicitly licenses all data CC BY 4.0; archive contains CIF supercells and defect results including relaxed CONTCAR geometry.

sources.title: Insights into oxygen vacancies from high-throughput first-principles calculations
sources.evidence: Primary paper reports 937 oxides and approximately 6,000 vacancy calculations across three charge states.

caveats: Released machine-learning CSVs have 1,745 neutral, 1,689 singly charged and 1,613 doubly charged rows; these filtered subsets are not the full calculation population.
Distinct from Foundry Wolverton ABO3 vacancy data and JARVIS vacancy release.
Later ML_charged_defects reuse of this oxygen corpus should not be added independently without new-data verification.

additional_counts.scope: Sum of charge0.csv (1745), charge1.csv (1689), charge2.csv (1613); overlapping hosts and sites

name: OQMD-derived oxygen-vacancy formation energies
description: Site-resolved computed oxygen-vacancy energies and descriptors for oxide materials, indexed to OQMD pristine and defect entries.
count_scope: Exact parsed Data.csv row count, excluding its header. Removing _v site suffixes gives 1,157 distinct pristine OQMD IDs.
provenance: Baldassarri–He–Wolverton high-throughput vacancy calculations on OQMD oxide hosts

sources.title: Zenodo oxygen-vacancy release metadata
sources.evidence: Open dataset with explicit cc-by-4.0 licence; Data.csv, Readme and example model code are distributed.

sources.title: Released Data.csv
sources.evidence: Parsed 2,677 data rows and 1,157 distinct parent IDs after removing _v site suffixes. Columns include OQMD_ID_defect and evf.

caveats: CSV provides structure identifiers and descriptors rather than self-contained coordinates.
Do not interpret 2,677 as the number of distinct pristine materials.
OQMD parent lineage is shared, but the released site-resolved vacancy labels are a distinct calculation corpus.

additional_counts.scope: Distinct OQMD_ID_pristine values after stripping _v site suffix

name: Chalcogenide vacancy structure-reconstruction dataset
description: DFT relaxation landscapes for neutral cation vacancies in chalcogenides, used to train defect reconstruction surrogate potentials.
count_scope: Provider describes approximately 130 defect types across approximately 50 chalcogenide hosts, each with 14 or 15 initial distortions and relaxation trajectories.
provenance: ShakeNBreak structure searches and VASP DFT relaxations; processed M3GNet training/validation configurations derived from the same trajectories
license: Not verified; Zenodo metadata did not expose an explicit dataset licence

sources.title: Machine-learning structural reconstructions dataset
sources.evidence: Release describes about 130 neutral cation vacancies, about 50 hosts, POSCAR/CONTCAR/vasprun.xml data and processed structure-energy-force-stress dictionaries.

caveats: Defect count excludes distortions, ionic frames, and pristine-host relaxations.
Some ionic steps are electronically unconverged and the supplied parser removes them.
Full 20.7 GB archives were not downloaded.

name: NIST MRAS amorphous structural models
description: Amorphous silicon, silica, hafnia, zirconium–copper and alumina structures generated by relaxation of random molecular arrangements.
count_scope: Ten CONTCAR structures in each of Si_Final, SiO2_Final, HfO2_Final, ZrCu_Final and Al2O3_Final; exploratory Si_Base structures are excluded.
provenance: Worden–Cockayne–Garrity random-arrangement relaxation workflows at NIST
license: NIST Open License; see linked dataset-specific metadata and NIST terms

sources.title: NIST MRAS release metadata
sources.evidence: Names five material systems and an open-licence URL; downloadable ZIP has publisher SHA-256 153d2889f34a86db89fbf08b96e64f8ac2312ea71dd74a57128b1ee5b264435c.

sources.title: NIST MRAS README
sources.evidence: Final directories contain ten CONTCAR systems apiece with density headers and workflows. Downloaded archive inventory confirms 50 final structures.

caveats: The archive also contains 240 exploratory silicon CONTCAR files; these are excluded from the final model count.
Computed amorphous models are not experimental determinations of atomic structure.

name: Amorphous alumina bulk/surface DFT training release
description: Extended-XYZ reference configurations for crystalline and amorphous alumina, plus large bulk/slab structures and trained Deep Potential models.
count_scope: Repository contains many trajectory XYZ files; frame count was not independently enumerated, so file count and atom counts are not substituted.
provenance: Active learning for amorphous Al2O3 bulk and surfaces with crystalline seed configurations
license: GPL-3.0 as explicitly applied to the repository containing data; inspect downstream distribution obligations

sources.title: Author alumina dataset repository
sources.evidence: README identifies extended XYZ DFT energies/forces/stresses/lattice vectors and bulk/surface LAMMPS structures. Repository licence explicitly states GNU GPL v3.

sources.title: Repository release tree
sources.evidence: Tree confirms data/amorphous and data/crystalline XYZ payloads, separate model files and representative structures.

caveats: Model committee members and atoms per cell are not independent configuration counts.
Unranked until XYZ frames are enumerated; no numerical size inferred from the paper or file sizes.

name: Fe–Ni–Cr irradiated and relaxed atomistic configurations
description: Two LAMMPS atomistic states for comparing radiation-damaged austenitic alloy structure with a relaxed reference.
count_scope: One post-irradiation state and one relaxed reference; atom counts and the preceding approximately 180 cascades are not additional released samples.
provenance: Molecular-dynamics configurations supporting the atomistic radiation-induced ductile-to-brittle transition study

sources.title: RepOD released dataset metadata
sources.evidence: V1 has two unrestricted files with CC BY 4.0; descriptions specify 262,080 atoms after irradiation and 1,048,320 atoms in the relaxed reference.

caveats: The two samples have different cell sizes; direct paired per-atom subtraction is inappropriate.
Not a release of 180 separate cascade trajectories.
Only archive metadata was inspected; atomistic payloads were not downloaded.
